title: Vectorial AOFVS maps beyond the half-dimension range
summary: Settle pointwise existence of even-dimensional vectorial maps whose every nonzero component has the required five-valued AOFVS spectrum.

formal_statement.body: For every even $n\ge4$ and every integer $m$ with $n/2+2\le m\le n$, determine whether there exists a map $F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^m$ such that, for every $c\in\mathbb F_2^m\setminus\{0\}$ and every $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the component Walsh value satisfies $W_{c\cdot F}(a)\in\{0,\pm2^{n/2},\pm2^{n/2+1}\}$.

scope.domain: Vectorial Boolean functions with almost-optimal five-valued component spectra
assumptions: Every nonzero component must satisfy the source's AOFVS spectrum condition
scope.unresolved_remainder: Settle existence separately for every even n >= 4 and every m with n/2 + 2 <= m <= n. The source's unspecified odd-n range is excluded from this record.

progress.summary: The source asks for vectorial AOFVS maps throughout the stated even-dimensional output range beyond its existing construction.
